skills.title: Observe, act, and re-observe
skills.trigger: Before every movement or interaction decision
procedure: Record the current phase, direction, and latest public progress cue.
Choose one bounded public action or short batch with an expected visible effect.
Re-observe and keep the plan unless new evidence falsifies it; never infer success from a claim.
successSignals: The host returns goal_reached and the public frame agrees.
failureSignals: The same scene/action signature repeats without new evidence or terminal host status is absent.
recovery: Perform one bounded information-gaining recovery action, then resume with a new guard.
invariants: Only host terminal status ends the episode.
No hidden coordinates or route trace is used.

skills.title: Calibrate opaque public actions from visible effects
skills.trigger: Before relying on an action whose current-episode effect is not yet confirmed
procedure: Read the action's current public contract description and record one expected observable effect without assuming semantics from its identifier.
Execute one bounded atomic instance, re-observe, and classify the result as confirmed, contradicted, ambiguous, or rejected from public evidence.
Persist only confirmed action-effect facts for the current episode; if contradicted or ambiguous, do not repeat or invert the action without a distinct precondition or information goal.
successSignals: A later decision cites a current-episode confirmed action-effect fact and its expected public consequence occurs.
failureSignals: An unconfirmed action is repeated, an inverse pair substitutes for evidence, or the identifier is treated as proof of its effect.
recovery: Preserve the contradiction and choose an independently grounded action or observation.
invariants: No game-specific action, route, coordinate, or mechanic is stored.

skills.title: Require host-confirmed terminal evidence
skills.trigger: When the goal appears visually near or apparently complete
procedure: Check the latest act response before making any completion claim.
If episodeEnded is false, continue with the smallest safe productive action.
Stop only on episodeEnded=true with reason=goal_reached or host budget exhaustion.
successSignals: A host-confirmed terminal response is present.
failureSignals: Player stops early or treats visual proximity as terminal.
recovery: Resume the current plan and re-observe; do not restart without evidence.
invariants: Player self-report never overrides the host.
